events.title: After graduation…
events.text: Diploma in hand (grades: {{s.education.grades}}). The future knocks.

then.tpl: Accepted! Dorm, debt, dreams. College begins.

else.tpl: Rejected / can't afford it. Community college or work instead?

effects.tpl: Smart frugal move. Same credits, tiny debt.
Straight to work. The school of life charges different fees.

events.title: Pre-approved!
events.text: {{s.firstName}} gets pre-approved for a $5,000 card. Free money, the letter whispers.

effects.tpl: Confetti. Your future self salutes you.
New everything! Then the 24% APR bill arrives. Net: minus $1,100 of wisdom.

events.title: Draft notice?
events.text: A letter: mandatory service lottery. Your number is up… maybe.

effects.tpl: Two years. Lifelong friends, iron discipline. +30 prestige!

then.tpl: Deferment granted. Study like the wind.

else.tpl: Denied — you serve. It builds you anyway.

events.title: Couch the size of a whale
events.text: Your best friend moves Saturday, owns a couch the size of a whale, and begs {{s.firstName}} for help. Pizza is on them.

effects.tpl: Third-floor walkup. The pizza tastes like triumph.
Your ankle heals suspiciously Monday. Friendship cools.

events.title: Roommate roulette
events.text: A stranger needs a roommate: half rent, unknown habits.

then.tpl: Instant best friend. Rent halved, joy doubled.

else.tpl: They eat your food at 3am and 'borrow' shirts. Lesson learned.

effects.tpl: Peace costs $4,000. Worth every cent.

events.title: Red and blue
events.text: Red and blue in the mirror while {{s.firstName}} drives home. 90 in a 65. The officer strolls over.

then.tpl: Dismissed on a technicality. Courtroom legend.

else.tpl: Fine plus traffic school. $320 lesson in velocity.

effects.tpl: $220 and points. Cruise control from now on.

events.title: Spring break!
events.text: Friends rent a beach house: $700 each. Sun, music, questionable decisions.

effects.tpl: Sunburns, salt, 4am talks. Core memory unlocked.
You cover shifts. The photos still hurt.

events.title: Adult hunger wakes
events.text: At {{s.age}}, alone in your room, your adult body finally demands to be touched — cock aching or pussy throbbing, sheets twisted, breath loud.

effects.tpl: You learn exactly where you cum hardest — fingers, rhythm, pressure. You finish shaking and grinning. Skill up.
You meet {{n}}, an adult who wants it as bad as you. Clumsy, wet, real first fucking — you cum together and laugh. Lover counted.

events.title: Someone experienced
events.text: An older adult lover (mid-20s) pins {{s.firstName}} to the mattress and murmurs: 'Let me show you how adults fuck.'

effects.tpl: They eat you out / suck you off until your thighs shake, then ride you slow and deep. You cum so hard you see white. Lesson burned in.
You flip them, hold their wrists down, fuck them hard while they beg louder. They leave with bite marks and your number.

events.title: First tax season
events.text: It is {{s.firstName}}'s first tax season. W-2s, 1099s, and a refund that could be real money.

then.tpl: Refund: $1,400! You did that with a free app.

effects.tpl: A pro finds deductions. Net plus $650 after the fee.

events.title: Singles table
events.text: A college friend invites {{s.firstName}} to a wedding: open bar, $150 gift expectation, singles table.

effects.tpl: You cry, dance, catch nothing. Perfect night.
You send a card. The photos hurt a little.

events.title: Turkey trot
events.text: Thanksgiving 5k. Costumes encouraged, pie at stake.

effects.tpl: Third in your age group. The pie tastes like victory.
Full turkey suit. You win the crowd, lose three minutes.

events.title: Jungle studio
events.text: One pothos becomes forty plants. The studio is a greenhouse.

effects.tpl: Forty plants, zero regrets. Air: delicious.
Cuttings for everyone. You earn 80 dollars and jungle goodwill.

events.title: Van tour
events.text: Six cities, one van, your band's first real tour.

effects.tpl: Floor-sleeping, gas-station glory. You sell merch and break even plus.
The tour film gets 100k views. Next tour: actual beds.

events.title: Gallon club
events.text: Your eighth donation earns a pin. The cookies are tradition.

effects.tpl: Gallon reached. Somewhere, strangers keep breathing.
Five first-timers join. The bus beats its record.

events.title: Wine and whines
events.text: A book club forms. Half finish the book. All finish the snacks.

effects.tpl: You carry discussions. The group upgrades because of you.
Themed snacks per chapter. Attendance: perfect.

events.title: The wall
events.text: You hit the wall at full speed. Something has to change.

effects.tpl: Sleep, sun, nothing. You return human.
Boundaries set, hours sane. The wall becomes a door.

events.title: Alone out there
events.text: One pack, one trail, three days of your own thoughts.

effects.tpl: Rain, peaks, silence. You return quieter and stronger.
A guided trip first. Skills banked for the solo next year.

events.title: Letters after name
events.text: A certification would bump pay 15 percent. The exam is brutal.

then.tpl: Passed! The raise lands: 5,000 dollars more yearly.

else.tpl: Failed by points. Second attempt scheduled, smarter.

effects.tpl: Skills grow free. The letters can wait.

events.title: Five years on
events.text: College reunion: same quad, new lives, old jokes.

effects.tpl: Dawn talks, bad singing, best weekend in years.
Your place, forty people, zero regrets. Legend status renewed.

events.title: Plot 12B
events.text: A community garden plot opens. The soil is willing.

effects.tpl: Tomatoes by July. Neighbors trade basil for beans.
Sunflowers eight feet tall. The block photographs them.

events.title: Chef arc
events.text: Takeout math shocks you. The kitchen awaits.

effects.tpl: Ten dishes mastered. Health up, spending down 400 dollars.
Five lunches, one hour. Weekdays run on rails.

events.title: Plastic temptation
events.text: Pre-approved for 5,000 dollars. The mall glows.

effects.tpl: scissors. The card dies unused. Future-you approves.
Locked in a drawer for true emergencies. Dentist, not jackets.

events.title: Cousin coin
events.text: Your cousin swears his coin will 100x. Family discount entry.

then.tpl: It pumps! You sell fast, up 1,500 dollars, out forever.

else.tpl: It rugs. 300 dollars tuition to the school of hype.

effects.tpl: You keep Thanksgiving peaceful and your savings intact.

events.title: App dating
events.text: Your profile is live. The first week brings chaos and hope.

then.tpl: Third date clicks. Deleted apps, kept person.

else.tpl: Funny stories, no spark. The group chat feasts.

effects.tpl: Real life, real people. The coffee shop delivers.

events.title: Locked in
events.text: The escape room record is 32 minutes. Your crew disagrees.

then.tpl: 29 minutes! Your photo joins the wall of fame.

else.tpl: One lock left at zero. The rematch is already booked.

effects.tpl: Screams, puzzles, triumph. The actor breaks character laughing.

events.title: Fantasy glory
events.text: Your fantasy team is one Sunday from the league crown.

then.tpl: Champions! 600 dollars and a year of bragging rights.

else.tpl: Second place. The group chat shows no mercy.

effects.tpl: Funniest manager award. The trophy is a tiny toilet. Cherished.

events.title: Mud and music
events.text: Three-day festival. Day two rains. The field becomes soup.

effects.tpl: Mud to the knees, headliner at dusk. Worth every stain.
You work gates, catch sets free. Dry socks included.

events.title: Keys at last
events.text: First apartment: one room, one window, total freedom.

effects.tpl: Curb finds and fresh paint. It feels like a palace.
Half the rent, double the stories. Choose wisely.

events.title: Beater with a heater
events.text: Two thousand dollars buys four wheels and a personality.

effects.tpl: It rattles, it runs, it is yours. Freedom smells like vinyl.
Bus year. Next spring buys twice the car.

events.title: Solo boarding
events.text: First solo flight: window seat, new city, nobody waiting.

effects.tpl: Lost twice, found everything. Solo travel rewires the brain.
You learn one neighborhood truly. The cafe knows your order.

events.title: Index awakening
events.text: A coworker explains index funds over lunch. The math lands.

effects.tpl: Monthly transfers start. Compounding begins its quiet magic.
Three books later, you invest with calm conviction.

events.title: House hunt
events.text: Rent math breaks. The suburbs list open houses.

effects.tpl: A small place with good bones. Equity begins.
You invest the difference instead. Flexibility compounds.

events.title: Offer letter
events.text: The offer letter lands: real salary, benefits, a start date.

then.tpl: Five thousand more base. One email, years of returns.

else.tpl: They hold firm, politely. You sign anyway, wiser.

effects.tpl: Dinner out. You toast the end of ramen month.

events.title: Kitten season
events.text: The shelter begs for fosters. Kitten season is chaos.

effects.tpl: Bean stays. The other finds a palace. Foster win, mostly.
Socializing kittens: the best job that pays in purrs.

events.title: Feast months
events.text: Three clients at once. Money pours; weekends vanish.

effects.tpl: You bank 7,000 dollars and sleep for a week after.
Two clients, sane hours, 4,000 dollars. Balance kept.

events.title: Couch guest era
events.text: A friend needs a couch for a month. Your lease says maybe.

effects.tpl: One month, clear rules, lifelong bond. They launch clean.
Written terms, kept friendship. Boundaries are love.

events.title: Friend's rocket
events.text: Your friend's startup offers equity and instant noodles.

then.tpl: It exits! Your slice: 25,000 dollars. Noodles to nice dinners.

else.tpl: It folds in eighteen months. The lessons are worth equity.

effects.tpl: Advisor shares, spare hours. Upside without the burn.

events.title: Wedding season
events.text: Third wedding this summer. The dance floor knows your name.

effects.tpl: Bouquet adjacent, twice. Your moves get requested.
A gift that matters. The couple cries. Worth it.

events.title: Wall space
events.text: A cafe offers your photos wall space for a month.

effects.tpl: Two sell! 600 dollars and a red dot apiece. Artist: exhibited.
One river, twelve moods. Visitors stay long and buy prints.

events.title: January resolution
events.text: New year, new membership, new you. Allegedly.

effects.tpl: By April: visible change. The habit sticks for real.
No fees, fresh air. The park is your gym now.

events.title: Hostel summer
events.text: A rail pass, a backpack, and thirty days of Europe.

effects.tpl: Twelve cities, nine hostels, one sunrise that rewires you.
Farm stays cover beds. You return broke-ish and fluent-ish.

events.title: Unpaid prestige
events.text: A famous firm offers an unpaid internship with golden promises.

then.tpl: They hire you! Junior title, real salary, foot in the door.

else.tpl: No offer, but the reference letter opens the next door.

effects.tpl: You take the paying job. Rent thanks you.

events.title: Fluent by fall
events.text: You vow fluency in a second language by fall.

effects.tpl: Dreams switch languages first. Then jokes. Then job interviews.
Weekly exchanges over coffee. Two languages, one friendship.

events.title: Rental roulette
events.text: The ceiling drips. The landlord says it adds character.

effects.tpl: Documented, dated, fixed. Renter power works.
Buckets placed, rent reduced 60 dollars. Character: tolerated.

events.text: The marathon entry is paid. Sixteen weeks of training await.

then.tpl: You finish upright, crying at mile 25. Medal: earned.

else.tpl: You walk-run to the line. Finishers medal anyway.

effects.tpl: 13.1 and smiling. The full waits for next year.

events.title: Coffee with a legend
events.text: A retired executive offers thirty minutes. Bring questions.

effects.tpl: One sentence changes your five-year plan. Mentorship begins.
Monthly coffees become a career compass. Priceless.

events.title: Taco truck o'clock
events.text: Midnight, downtown, the legendary truck with the endless line.

effects.tpl: Al pastor at 1am. The line was the appetizer. Worth it.
Four friends, one feast. The truck becomes tradition.

events.title: Big city leap
events.text: The big city offers a job, a closet apartment, and everything.

then.tpl: It works! Raises stack to 8,000 extra. The skyline is yours.

else.tpl: Tough year, great stories. You return seasoned, not defeated.

effects.tpl: You bloom locally. Roots deepen, costs stay low.

events.title: Night differential
events.text: Nights pay 20 percent more. Sleep pays nothing.

effects.tpl: A year of nights banks 5,200 extra. You sleep at dawn like a vampire king.
Days kept. Energy kept. Money: enough.

events.title: Five minutes
events.text: Open mic standup. Your set is five minutes of almost-truth.

then.tpl: Real laughs, twice. The host invites you back.

else.tpl: Silence, one pity laugh, then a great story. Everyone starts here.

effects.tpl: Your jokes kill in a funnier mouth. Credit and gratitude.

events.title: Inspection visit
events.text: Parents visit Saturday. The apartment is a crime scene.

effects.tpl: It sparkles. Mom checks behind the fridge anyway. Pass.
Your lasagna silences all criticism. Dad asks for seconds.

events.title: Photo a day
events.text: A photo every day for a year. Day one starts now.

effects.tpl: Day 365: a year of seeing. The book prints beautifully.
Fifty-two frames, all keepers. Sustainable art.

events.title: Paddle convert
events.text: Everyone plays pickleball now. The courts multiply.

effects.tpl: Soft hands, sharp angles. The retirees respect you.
Tuesday league, lifelong rivals, endless rematches.

events.title: Ring math
events.text: Two years in. The question glows on the horizon.

effects.tpl: Sunset, shaking knees, yes. The photos make grandparents weep.
Long talks first. Aligned, excited, ready when ready.

events.title: First dog
events.text: The shelter has a dog with your eyes. Landlord says maybe.

effects.tpl: Miso II comes home. Walks fix everything.
Two weeks foster. The dog was always staying. Everyone knew.

events.title: Ramen month
events.text: Rent took everything. The pantry holds noodles and hope.

effects.tpl: You survive on 40 dollars. The spreadsheet glows.
Two catering shifts. Noodles upgraded to real food.

events.title: Same ladder
events.text: You and a work friend chase one promotion.

then.tpl: You get it. The raise is 6,000 dollars and the friendship survives.

else.tpl: They get it. You congratulate them and plot your next move.

effects.tpl: You celebrate them loudly. Your turn comes within the year.

events.title: Coast run
events.text: Four friends, one old car, the whole coastline.

effects.tpl: Salt, sunsets, breakdowns laughed through. The photos live forever.
Two days, all highlights. Back with stories and savings.

events.title: Dish cold war
events.text: The sink is a mountain range. Nobody claims it.

effects.tpl: Signed, laminated, enforced. Peace in our sink.
You reset the kitchen. Shame does the rest.

events.title: Roommate plus one
events.text: Your roommate's friend keeps appearing at dinner. Sparks considered.

then.tpl: Dinner number four becomes date number one. The apartment approves.

else.tpl: Friendly no. Dinners continue, slightly awkward, then fine.

effects.tpl: Game nights forever. The friend group solidifies.

events.title: Dawn run club
events.text: Tuesdays, 6am, all paces. Coffee after.

effects.tpl: Miles stack, friendships stack higher. Racing by fall.
No drop policy. You bring three beginners to their first 5k.

events.title: Salsa Tuesdays
events.text: Free salsa lessons downtown. Two left feet welcome.

effects.tpl: By month three: spins, dips, numbers exchanged. Rhythm found.
Five friends, ten left feet, one glorious video.

events.title: Freelance nights
events.text: A client offers weekend work at real rates. Sleep is negotiable.

effects.tpl: Six weekends, 2,400 dollars, one exhausted triumph.
Rest chosen. Monday-you arrives sharp and grateful.

events.title: Season pass math
events.text: The pass costs 600 dollars. Powder costs nothing.

effects.tpl: Forty days ridden. Cost per day: pocket change. Soul: full.
Five perfect days, chosen by forecast. Discipline tastes like powder.

events.title: 48-hour build
events.text: A startup weekend: pitch Friday, demo Sunday.

then.tpl: Second place! 5,000 dollars seed and a team that believes.

else.tpl: No prize, but an investor wants coffee. That is the real win.

effects.tpl: You ship in 48 hours. Demo day applause tastes like future.

events.title: Tax day lessons
events.text: First year filing solo. The forms stare back.

effects.tpl: Filed, refunded, educated. 400 dollars back.
A pro finds deductions you never would. Worth every cent.

events.title: Defense day
events.text: The thesis defense: one hour, three professors, your whole degree.

effects.tpl: You answer everything. Handshakes, signatures, degree.
Calm, clear, done. The robe fits perfectly.

events.title: Weekend stall
events.text: Your candles sell out at every market. Scale or savor?

effects.tpl: Online shop opens. You clear 3,200 dollars extra.
Small batches, happy hands. 1,200 dollars of joy money.

events.title: Backyard hens
events.text: City code allows three hens. Fresh eggs whisper your name.

effects.tpl: Three hens, daily eggs, endless entertainment. Breakfast: solved.
Shared coop, shared eggs, shared joy. The alley clucks.

events.title: Hammer weekends
events.text: Weekend builds raise walls for families. Lunch provided, meaning included.

effects.tpl: Walls rise by Sunday. A family gets keys because of your crew.
You learn trim and tile. The punch list fears you.
